title: The Missing Feature That Could Change Mobile Soccer Games Forever
body: 🚨🚨🚨🚨🗣️🗣️ A lot of soccer games are missing a huge opportunity. Most mobile soccer games feel exactly the same build a team, collect players, and manage a club. That’s fine, but where is the innovation? Add a true Career Mode where players can create and control a single athlete from the beginning of their journey. Let us start as an unknown prospect, earn our spot on a roster, fight for playing time, build our reputation, sign contracts, win championships, and compete against other created players online. Keep the traditional manager mode for people who enjoy controlling an entire team, but give players another way to experience the game. Console sports games became popular because they gave players the chance to live out their own story. Mobile gaming has the audience, but very few developers are offering that experience. Not everyone wants to manage a club. Some of us want to create ourselves, build our legacy, and become the star. Being different is how games separate themselves from the competition. A deep “Road to Glory” style mode would attract casual players, hardcore sports fans, content creators, and competitive gamers alike. It would increase player engagement, retention, and long-term loyalty because people become emotionally invested in the careers they build. Instead of making another copy of what’s already on the market, create something players have been asking for. Give us the ability to create a player, build a career, and write our own story. If a mobile soccer game delivers that experience at a high level, it won’t just attract players it could redefine the entire genre.

title: The game have so much potential
body: I just played Total Football on mobile, and I have some feedback. The gameplay is actually really good. There’s a lot of space between players, so you can create plays, score great goals, and enjoy the match. However, there are still some things that need improvement. The pitch and the overall feel of the game don’t look very realistic. The player movement feels a bit robotic, and the match commentary isn’t very enjoyable to listen to. Also, the goal net physics need improvement. When you score, the net barely reacts and feels too stiff, almost like it’s made of wood, which makes scoring less satisfying. The player kits also need work. The jerseys look too stiff instead of moving naturally, making them look unrealistic. Overall, the game has a lot of positives, but there are also several areas that could be improved. I hope the developers continue to release updates because these small details really make a big difference. The gameplay has a lot of potential, and improving these details would make the game even better.

title: Hola, equipo de Total Football. 👋⚽ Quiero compartir una petición que creo que muchos jugadores de
body: Hola, equipo de Total Football. 👋⚽ Quiero compartir una petición que creo que muchos jugadores de la comunidad apoyarían. Total Football tiene algo que lo hace especial: sus físicas se sienten muy realistas. Por ejemplo, cuando un jugador está mal posicionado puede intentar rematar con la otra pierna, y ese tipo de situaciones hacen que los partidos se sientan naturales e impredecibles. También me gustan mucho las celebraciones de los jugadores. Celebraciones inspiradas en futbolistas como Cristiano Ronaldo y Mbappé hacen que marcar un gol se sienta mucho más emocionante. Pero creo que hay una característica que podría hacer que Total Football fuera todavía mejor: un verdadero Modo Carrera de Jugador. 🙏 Nos gustaría poder crear nuestro propio futbolista, comenzar como una joven promesa, elegir nuestra posición, mejorar nuestras habilidades, luchar por un puesto en el equipo, recibir ofertas de otros clubes, cambiar de equipo, jugar competiciones internacionales y construir nuestra propia historia hasta convertirnos en una estrella. Sería increíble que nuestras actuaciones dentro de los partidos realmente afectaran nuestra carrera: minutos jugados, goles, asistencias, calificación, confianza del entrenador, convocatorias con la selección, premios individuales y mucho más. La combinación de las excelentes físicas que ya tiene Total Football, sus animaciones y celebraciones realistas, junto con un Modo Carrera de Jugador profundo, podría convertirlo en uno de los mejores juegos de fútbol para móviles. No queremos solamente jugar partidos. Queremos vivir nuestra propia carrera como futbolistas. ❤️⚽ Por favor, consideren esta petición de parte de la comunidad. ¡Gracias por seguir mejorando Total Football! 🙌
